request.style: English, Latin salsa romántica, a warm female voice telling the parable, piano montuno, congas, bongos, a trumpet section and soft strings, smooth and celebratory, 94 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A woman had ten silver coins
And one of them was lost
She lit a lamp and swept the house
She searched at any cost

[Chorus]
Rejoice with me, rejoice with me
For I have found the coin I lost
There is joy before the angels of God
Over one who turns back home

[Verse]
And when she found it, she called her friends
Her neighbors gathered round
Come, celebrate with me tonight
The lost coin has been found

[Chorus]
Rejoice with me, rejoice with me
For I have found the coin I lost
There is joy before the angels of God
Over one who turns back home
